probe.question: What are we still waiting on, and how long has any of it been outstanding?
forbids_claims: that this is a complete list of the team's open work
an item nobody raised through this system
a person's workload, capacity or responsiveness
probe.direction: Answerable, with one boundary that has to be stated rather than implied. The inbox holds every question *this system* raised and is still waiting on, with what was asked, why, who it is routed to, when it is due and how many times it has been chased — so ordering by deadline and naming what is overdue is a real answer. The boundary is scope: it knows nothing about work raised anywhere else, so presenting it as the group's outstanding items would be a list that looks complete and is not. A request routed to nobody in particular is waiting on whoever is entitled, not on nobody, and should not be reported as unassigned in a way that implies it has been dropped.
